feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: Supreme Court allows Trump's ballroom construction to continue
entry.summary: The Supreme Court is allowing construction to continue on the White House ballroom over dissents from the chief justice and the court's three liberals.

entry.title: Why the Supreme Court's ballroom ruling could matter beyond the ballroom
entry.summary: Georgetown Law professor Stephen Vladeck explains the separation-of-powers questions raised by the Supreme Court's decision on the White House ballroom.

entry.title: Former gang member found guilty of orchestrating murder of rapper Tupac Shakur
entry.summary: Jurors convicted a former gang member of the death of Tupac Shakur. Duane Davis didn't pull the trigger in the 1996 drive-by shooting of the rap icon but admitted to orchestrating the killing.

entry.title: AI wealth is creating a 'mansion shortage' and upending San Francisco's housing market
entry.summary: Spiking prices and rental bidding wars are raising fears of more displacement in a city where previous tech booms and a housing shortage have already driven out many.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Supreme Court allows President Trump to continue construction of White House ballroom, Army Secretary Dan Driscoll steps down, world finance leaders meet in North Carolina for G-20 summit.

entry.title: Bluegrass guitarist Billy Strings honors his late mother with new album
entry.summary: NPR's A Martinez speaks with folk/bluegrass guitarist Billy Strings, whose new album "So Much for Goodbyes" pays tribute to his late mother.

entry.title: Affordability is the centerpiece of Democrats' message in Pennsylvania swing district
entry.summary: A rematch in a swing district Pennsylvania is showcasing how Republican messaging from 2024 is getting a replay, this time from Democratic candidates.

entry.title: Messi announces retirement from Argentina's national team
entry.summary: NPR's A Martinez speaks with Financial Times sports columnist Simon Kuper about soccer superstar Lionel Messi's announcement that he is retiring from Argentina's national team.

entry.title: Chance for more rain makes rescue operations perilous after Grand Canyon flooding
entry.summary: Ongoing rain chances are making search and rescue operations at the Grand Canyon more hazardous following Saturday's deadly flooding.

entry.title: Global finance ministers gather in North Carolina for G20 summit
entry.summary: The U.S. is playing host to finance ministers from around the world this week. Russia's top economic official made a stir on Monday when he showed up in person at the meeting in North Carolina.
